goals.text: Land the FIRST paying dental clinic for the AI receptionist (Rs 3,000/month retainer). This is the gate for everything else: T20 essays, Emergent Ventures, the brand's proof.
Build a T20 (MIT-level) application: hit competition deadlines (NASA Space Apps, Diamond Challenge, Conrad, IRIS, Rise) and show real community impact.
Deliver free AI-scam safety sessions at Delhi/Noida senior care homes: community impact for T20, real-world content, and warm access to residents' adult children.
Grow @revengineee with proof-backed content: named series built from real events (failures, costs, real deployments), not invented topics.
Keep the automated pipelines and credentials healthy so they keep running without attention.

reelRecipe: 1. Series banner on screen in the first 2 seconds (the series name in brand burgundy).
2. 8 to 10 one-second clips, 15 to 25 seconds total, text on screen for every beat (people watch muted).
3. Hook line = the first on-screen text. Never start with 'hey guys' or your name.
4. Post on @revengineee between 7 and 9 PM IST. Caption: hook line, 2 to 3 short lines of context, one question to invite comments.
5. Blur every client name, phone number and email before it goes on screen.
6. Out of energy? The lazy backup counts: 20 to 30 seconds of raw screen recording on @revengine.notes. Never skip two days in a row.

brandDays.reel: My sales bot sent one doctor 16 replies
posts: Write the full post: what the bot did, why, the fix
how: SOURCE: client-acquisition-pipeline reply handler bug, fixed in commit 8e8fb74. Real numbers: 16 replies between 17 and 24 Sep, 4 per run, because every run re-answered every message from the last 7 days.
SHOTS: blurred inbox showing the reply stack, the old code line (7-day window loop), the fixed code (newest message only, skip if older than last reply), a counter going 16 to 1.
ON SCREEN: 'My bot replied to a doctor 16 times' / 'Each run answered every old email again' / 'Fix: answer only the newest one' / 'Cost: one very annoyed doctor'.
RULES: never show her name, email or clinic. Say 'a dentist'.
POST: what happened, the one-line mistake, the fix, the cost, the lesson: anything that runs on a schedule must remember what it already did.

brandDays.reel: It also invented 3 different excuses
how: SOURCE: same incident. The doctor asked a question the bot had no true data for, and it gave three different made-up reasons across replies.
SHOTS: three blurred reply snippets side by side, each with a red 'invented' stamp, then the new rule: lead goes to stage=handoff and a human (you) takes over.
ON SCREEN: 'She asked 1 question' / 'It gave 3 different answers' / 'All 3 were made up' / 'Now: a hard question = a human answers'.
LESSON LINE: an AI that cannot say 'I don't know' will lie politely.
LINKEDIN: carousel version, 'Humans still needed here' angle.

brandDays.reel: My AI video pipeline wrote confident lies 3 times
how: SOURCE: format-engine, Kosmos 954 brief. Three regenerations, three confident fabrications: 'Venera 9 broke apart in Earth orbit in 1978' (it was a Venus mission), the wrong investigation commission, 'an anti-satellite RTG platform' (it was a radar satellite with a uranium reactor). One version had every date right and the facts still wrong.
SHOTS: each wrong claim on screen with a red strike, then the real fact in cream.
ON SCREEN: 'I asked AI to write a space documentary' / claim 1 struck / claim 2 struck / claim 3 struck / 'Every date was right. The facts were not.'

brandDays.reel: The fix: make it read the source first
how: SOURCE: format-engine grounding: it now pulls the Wikipedia article first and may only use names, dates and numbers from it. After that, unsupported claims went from 3 to 0.
SHOTS: diagram 'topic -> Wikipedia -> facts -> script', the verify command printing 0 unsupported, then the one line it still missed ('The Soviets paid', they paid about half).
ON SCREEN: 'Retrieve first, write second' / '3 lies -> 0' / 'It still missed one. I check every script by eye.'
LINKEDIN: carousel 'Why AI needs a source, not a better prompt'.

brandDays.reel: The bug that was in the input, not the AI
how: SOURCE: the package topic was 'space disaster', a category, which Wikipedia resolved to the Challenger article. Four regenerations were spent fixing the generator for an input problem.
ON SCREEN: 'I fixed the AI 4 times' / 'The input said space disaster' / 'Wikipedia heard Challenger' / 'Check what goes in before blaming what comes out'.

seniorPrep.title: Verify the 4 helplines and portals still work before anything gets printed
how: Check each one is live and correct today: 1930 (cyber crime helpline, call it and listen to the IVR), cybercrime.gov.in, Sanchar Saathi (sancharsaathi.gov.in, Chakshu for reporting fraud calls), PIB Fact Check.
Write anything that changed in the outcome box. These numbers go on a laminated card, so a wrong one stays wrong for years.

seniorPrep.title: Make the voice-clone demo clip from YOUR OWN voice
how: Record 60 seconds of yourself reading anything, quiet room, phone mic is fine.

Clone it with a free tool: search Hugging Face Spaces for 'F5-TTS' and use a public Space, upload your clip, generate a 20-second ordinary line ('Hi, it's me, I'm going to be late, can you call me back on this number?').
Save the output as an MP3 on your laptop (offline, the venue wifi will fail).
ETHICS: your voice only, or a staff member with same-day written consent. Never a resident's family member. Delete the clone audio after the sessions and say so on stage.

seniorPrep.title: Test the reveal on one family member
how: Play the clip without warning: 'Was that me speaking, or a computer?'
If there is no visible reaction, the clip is not good enough. Re-record or pick a more natural line. The whole session hangs on this moment.

seniorPrep.title: Design and print the A5 take-home card (do this once a date is booked)
how: A5, 20pt minimum, English front, Hindi back. Laminate. Print 1.5x the expected headcount (staff want them too).

FRONT: 1. HANG UP. Call back on the number saved in your phone. 2. Nobody legitimate ever asks for your OTP or PIN. Nobody. 3. Police and CBI do not video call and do not ask for money. 4. Our family safe word is: ________
BACK: Cyber crime helpline: 1930 / Report online: cybercrime.gov.in / My bank: ____ / Care home staff: ____ / Family contact: ____
Canva free is enough. Any print shop near school can laminate.

seniorPrep.title: Build the 22-slide deck (once a date is booked)
how: Full slide-by-slide outline: Deliverables/ai-safety-seniors-course-outline-2026-09-04.md section 5.

Order: Module 0 hook (play your clone, 4 min) / Voice cloning and the phone call (13 min) / Fake political ads and forwards (10 min) / Spotting AI images (8 min) / If it already happened (6 min) / Close and Q&A.
Big text, few words, Hindi labels where the home prefers Hindi. Download every audio and video file into the deck folder.

seniorPrep.title: Confirm logistics with the booked home (2 days before)
how: Ask: projector or big TV? Expected headcount? English, Hindi or mixed? Best slot (usually mid-morning after breakfast, or after evening tea)? Written permission to photograph?
Bring: laptop, charger, HDMI + adapters, your own Bluetooth speaker, all media offline, laminated cards, pens, whiteboard marker.

seniorCallHow: WHEN: caretakers pick up 10 AM to 6 PM. After school (3 to 6 PM) or weekend mornings.
GOAL OF THIS CALL: get the name of whoever arranges activities and a time to talk. That alone is a successful call.
OPENING (do not pitch yet): 'Namaste, main Shaurya bol raha hoon. Kya main us vyakti se baat kar sakta hoon jo residents ke liye activities ya programmes arrange karte hain?'

ONCE YOU HAVE THEM (20 seconds max): 'Sir/Ma'am, main ek student hoon aur voice AI par kaam karta hoon. Main senior citizens ke liye ek free 45-minute session karta hoon, AI phone scams ke upar. Aaj kal scammers awaaz copy karke phone karte hain. Main live demo dikhata hoon aur bachne ka tareeka batata hoon. Bilkul free hai, kuch bechna nahi hai. Kya aapke residents ko yeh useful lagega?'
THEN STOP TALKING. Do not fill the silence.
IF YES: 'Kaun sa din theek rahega? Aur kitne log honge, taaki main utne cards print karwa loon?' Also ask: 'Aapke residents ko aajkal kaun se scam calls aa rahe hain?'
IF 'SEND DETAILS': get their WhatsApp number (not email) and send the WhatsApp text below right away.
IF NO: 'Koi baat nahi. Agar aap kisi aur home ko jaante hain jinhe zaroorat ho, to bata dijiyega.'

WHATSAPP TEXT (Hindi): 'Namaste [Name] ji, main Shaurya, Delhi se. Main voice AI systems banata hoon. Main senior citizens ke liye 45 minute ka free session karta hoon, jisme AI phone scams ke baare mein batata hoon. Aaj kal scammers kisi ke bete ya pote ki awaaz copy karke phone karte hain aur emergency bata kar paise maangte hain. Main live dikhata hoon ki yeh kaise hota hai, aur phir woh ek simple niyam sikhata hoon jisse yeh bilkul kaam nahi karega. Sabko ek printed card milta hai jisme helpline number hote hain. Bilkul free hai, kuch bhi bechna nahi hai. Kya [Home Name] mein yeh useful hoga?'
FOLLOW-UP: day 4 WhatsApp the card image (once it exists), day 9 call again with a specific date, day 16 close it out politely and ask for a referral.
LOG: write the outcome in the box (who you spoke to, yes/no/callback time). Never collect resident phone numbers, bank details or Aadhaar.

clinicHow: WHEN: 11 AM to 12:30 PM or 3 to 5 PM (between patients). Weekday after school works for the nearest one.
WALK IN, ask for the doctor or owner. If they are busy, ask the front desk one question: 'How many calls do you miss when you are with a patient?' and come back.

30-SECOND OPENER: 'Hi, I'm Shaurya, a student at DPS RK Puram. I built an AI receptionist that answers your clinic's phone when nobody can, in Hindi and English, and books the appointment. Can I show you in one minute?'

DEMO: open the VAPI dashboard on your phone, Marudhar Dental assistant, 'Talk to Assistant'. Ask it INFO questions only (timings, location, fees). Do not try a booking live: the booking webhook is not deployed and it hangs for ~20 seconds.
OFFER: a free 7-day trial on calls they already miss (after hours first). Prices only if they ask: Rs 3,000/month core, Rs 6,000/month full front desk, prepaid, any month with zero bookings is free.
DO NOT SAY '2 clinics already use it' until that number is confirmed (handoff h-proof-count).
LEGAL: you are a minor, so a parent or guardian signs any contract later and payments go to the guardian's UPI. The trial needs no signature.
CAPTURE in the outcome box: who answers calls today, how many numbers they list, rough missed calls per day, their reaction, follow-up date.
